breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the flawed instruction: 'Use a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of applied torques over the full length for both stress and twist calculations.' The ground truth removes this incorrect directive entirely, allowing the internal torque to be treated as piecewise constant across the two segments. The agent failed to eliminate this error and instead preserved it verbatim, even while contradictorily also mentioning two segments.
